items.headline: 'Dune: Part Three' drops its trailer — and the internet lost it
items.body: Denis Villeneuve and Timothée Chalamet finally pulled the curtain back on 'Dune: Part Three,' the trilogy-ending chapter, and the new trailer set off a proper fan frenzy this week. Zendaya, Florence Pugh and Javier Bardem are all back as Paul Atreides' reign spirals toward all-out war, with Robert Pattinson joining as a menacing new face. It lands in theaters and IMAX on December 18 — but the footage is the movie talk of the moment.
items.say: The Dune: Part Three trailer just dropped and it looks unreal — it's the big finale, out in December, and Robert Pattinson's in this one. You into the Dune movies?

items.headline: Camp's already spicy — a record DT deal and a couple of star holdouts
items.body: The pads aren't even on and the drama's flying. The Eagles made Jalen Carter the highest-paid defensive tackle in NFL history with a four-year, $152 million extension (about $106M guaranteed). Meanwhile the money fights are simmering elsewhere: Bucs star left tackle Tristan Wirfs reported but won't practice until he gets a new deal, and Commanders receiver Terry McLaurin ended a four-day holdout by showing up — still without one.
items.say: Football camps are open and the drama started before anyone threw a pass — the Eagles just made Jalen Carter the highest-paid D-tackle ever, and a couple of stars are holding out for new contracts. You following your team's camp?

items.headline: Ariana Grande is back — new album 'Petal' drops Friday
items.body: Ariana Grande's eighth album, 'petal,' arrives Friday — her first full record since 'Eternal Sunshine.' The lead single 'Hate That I Made You Love Me' already shot straight to No. 1, and she teased the new era beautifully on Monday, surprising her Montreal crowd by debuting the title track live on opening night of that leg of her Eternal Sunshine Tour. A big pop moment to have on your radar this weekend.
items.say: Ariana Grande's got a new album out Friday — her first in a couple years. She actually debuted one of the new songs live in Montreal a couple nights ago. You into her stuff?

items.headline: The Premier League giants are back on the grass — friendly season heats up
items.body: Club soccer is stirring back to life. The Premier League's big names are deep into their summer tours before the season kicks off — Manchester United already hammered Rosenborg 5-0, Arsenal are tuning up ahead of an Aug 16 Community Shield clash with Man City, and this weekend brings marquee tune-ups like United vs. Atlético Madrid in Stockholm and Arsenal vs. Girona. Real football to ease you back in.
items.say: Premier League preseason's rolling — the big clubs are doing their tour friendlies before the season starts, and Arsenal vs Man City for the Community Shield is coming up soon. You follow the Premier League? Who do you support?

items.headline: James Cameron returns — the 'Avatar: Fire and Ash' trailer arrives
items.body: The first full trailer for 'Avatar: Fire and Ash,' the third Pandora epic from James Cameron, dropped this week — volcano-lit battles, a Sully family more fractured than ever, and a fearsome new fire-wielding Na'vi clan known as the 'Ash People.' It's the next chapter in the biggest movie franchise on the planet, landing in theaters December 19. Pure big-screen spectacle.
items.say: The new Avatar trailer — 'Fire and Ash' — just came out. It's Cameron's third one, with a whole new fire clan of Na'vi, and it's out right before Christmas. You seen the trailer yet?

items.headline: The WNBA is back tonight — the season resumes after the All-Star break
items.body: Rested up from All-Star weekend, the WNBA flips back to business Wednesday night with a full slate — including the expansion Golden State Valkyries visiting the Phoenix Mercury and the Atlanta Dream at the Dallas Wings. The scramble for playoff seeding starts now, so if you got hooked on the Caitlin Clark / Paige Bueckers era this summer, this is where the stretch run gets tense.
items.say: The WNBA's back tonight after the All-Star break — real games again, and the playoff race is heating up. Good one to throw on. You been keeping up with the WNBA this year?

items.headline: One last ride — 'The Proud Family: Louder and Prouder' begins its final season
items.body: A nostalgia hit for the whole family: the fourth and final season of 'The Proud Family: Louder and Prouder' starts today on Disney+, closing out a story that began 25 years ago. Kyla Pratt is back as Penny Proud, and the send-off promises the usual big laughs and heart — plus Suga Mama dominating a roller-derby track and a mysterious lake cryptid turning up. A sweet, easy watch if you grew up with the Prouds.
items.say: The Proud Family's final season just dropped on Disney+ — the show's been around 25 years now. If you grew up watching it, it's a fun nostalgic one to close out. You ever watch that?

items.headline: The kids are crashing DC — teen breakouts as American seeds keep tumbling
items.body: The DC Open has turned into an upset factory. After Frances Tiafoe's early exit, more American men fell — Tommy Paul and Learner Tien both got bounced — while the next generation announced itself: 17-year-old Cruz Hewitt (yes, Lleyton's son) won his first-ever ATP match, and fellow teen Rafael Jodar stunned Arthur Fils. Amid the chaos, Taylor Fritz calmly rolled to his 250th career hard-court win. Fun, wide-open tennis on the road to the US Open.
items.say: The DC Open's been wild — a bunch of the American guys keep getting knocked out, and Lleyton Hewitt's 17-year-old kid Cruz just won his first pro match. The young players are taking over. You watch any tennis?

items.headline: Lollapalooza takes over Chicago from Thursday — Lorde headlines night one
items.body: The biggest US music festival kicks off its four-day run in Chicago's Grant Park on Thursday, and Day 1 is loaded: Lorde and dance star John Summit headline, with 5 Seconds of Summer, Blood Orange, Little Simz, Wet Leg and Empire of the Sun also on the bill. Whether you're there or just catching the sets as they pop up online, Lolla is the music conversation for the next few days.
items.say: Lollapalooza kicks off in Chicago on Thursday — Lorde's headlining the first night. Even if you're not there, the clips end up everywhere. You ever done a big festival like that?
